name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ani_decoder). Descriptor accurately reflects body: a frame-dispatch chunk handler (slot @ data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_frame_dispatch_table + 0x10 = 0x5277A, the sole DATA xref to this function) that fills one full row (target_width bytes) in the destination buffer with a single broadcast byte value. 'row' distinguishes it from the palette-area sibling fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_fill_byte (which fills the 768-byte palette at src_buf); 'fill_byte' distinguishes it from row_copy_literal / row_decode_rle. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: ANI frame-decoder chunk handler (dispatch slot @ table+0x10): fill one full destination row (data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_target_width bytes) with a single byte value read from the frame stream.
logic_summary: Reads one byte from the ANI frame stream cursor (LODSB consumes *ESI++ = the fill value), broadcasts it across all 4 bytes of EAX (AH=AL; BX=AX; EAX<<=16; AX=BX -> EAX=bbbb), loads EBX=target_width (ushort @ 0x52760) and EDI=dst_buf (@ 0x52762), then REP STOSD with ECX=width>>2 (width/4 dwords) followed by REP STOSB with CL=width&3 (remainder bytes). Equivalent to memset(dst_buf, val, target_width). No return value; advances stream cursor by 1.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: writes target_width bytes (one broadcast value) into the destination row at data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_dst_buf; advances the frame-stream cursor (ESI in binary / g_ani_cursor in C) by 1 consumed byte.

reads_globals: g_ani_cursor (file-scope static stream cursor; binary uses ESI register)
writes_globals: g_ani_cursor (file-scope static stream cursor; binary uses ESI register)
*data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_dst_buf (destination row buffer pointed to by dst_buf; the global pointer itself is only read)
notes: Source (anidec.c lines 163-171) is already a correct, concise C equivalent: val=*g_ani_cursor++; width=target_width; memset(dst_buf, val, width). The binary's REP STOSD (width/4 dwords) + REP STOSB (width&3 bytes) == width-byte fill == memset. Row-buffer analog of the palette sibling fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_palette_fill_byte (0x36AE7); same broadcast-then-fill idiom but width/dst_buf-driven instead of fixed 768/src_buf. Source comment block (lines 158-162) is accurate and concise -> keep. Ghidra plate is far more detailed (register protocol, algorithm, dispatch+caller chain: fd2_play_ani_file_animation_sequence -> fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes @ 0x36C9E -> indirect via table @ 0x5276A -> here) and consistent with the source understanding -> not modified (ghidra_plate_action=none). Function is void(void) so params=[]. The binary's stream cursor is the ESI register handed off by the dispatcher fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes; the C port models it via file-scope static g_ani_cursor. memset here is the canonical fill idiom and is the existing (already-verified) code; not a timing-sensitive scaling/blit hot loop, so no codegen-shape concern.
